source:
@@U01337@@
This evening, then, in the garden behind the house.

@@U01339@@
浮士德. 梅菲斯特.

@@U01341@@
How’s it going? You getting anywhere? How much longer will it be?

@@U01343@@
Ah, bravo! All on fire, are we? She'll be yours in just a bit. You'll see her this evening at neighbor 玛尔特's. If ever a woman was born to be a Gypsy bawd, she’s it!

@@U01345@@
Fine!

@@U01347@@
She'll expect a small favor of us, though.

@@U01349@@
One good turn deserves another.

@@U01351@@
We're to swear a deposition that her husband’s bones rest in consecrated ground. Ah, in Padua, yes!

@@U01353@@
Very clever! Except that first we'll have to go there!
translation:
@@U01337@@
那么，今天晚上，在屋后的花园里。

@@U01339@@
浮士德。 梅菲斯特。

@@U01341@@
怎么样？你有进展吗？还要多久？

@@U01343@@
啊，太棒了！都着火了，是吗？过一会儿她就会属于你了。今晚你会在邻居玛尔特家见到她。如果有一个女人生来就是吉普赛妓女，那么她就是了！

@@U01345@@
好吧！

@@U01347@@
不过，她会期待我们的一点帮助。

@@U01349@@
一次好的转机值得另一次转机。

@@U01351@@
我们要宣誓作证，保证她丈夫的尸骨安息在圣地。啊，在帕多瓦，是的！

@@U01353@@
非常聪明！不过我们首先得去那里！
